This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Economics specification.

Economic Objectives and the Role of Government appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Economic Objectives and the Role of Government in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Economic Objectives and the Role of Government.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
